name: dogfood-macos-memory-lane
description: macOS daily ordinary-use dogfood profile: memory-learning + preference-learning T1 overlays + evaluation outcome/agreement recording active; proactive and work-items strictly pinned to observe mode; attention loosening and engineering auto-adoption disabled.
applyCommands: dsh-rsi open --profile web   # open Web UI and create/open one chat session to bind the idle owner Session, then stop Host (Ctrl-C)
dsh-rsi open --profile web   # restart Host for daily dogfood use with memory-learning and T1 preference overlays active
ownerConsoleAlternative: During step 2 (`dsh-rsi open --profile web`), after creating a chat session, you may instead complete three-way memory-learning authorization inside Settings -> 文鳐助手 -> 自主学习与三权授权向导 (Conservative tier + Memory Learning), then restart the Host once (`Ctrl-C` followed by `dsh-rsi open --profile web`) so non-volatile `cordis.patch.yml` grants activate.

proactiveLooseningDecisionGate.rule: Keep attentionLooseningEnabled=false and intakeLedger.evaluation.admit.enabled=false until growth-report shows >= 20 decided holdout samples without rising negative rate.
